title: Gumagana Ba ang Solar Kapag Maulan?
premise: Clouds and rain reduce output, sometimes a lot, but generation is often not zero because diffuse light still reaches the panels; judge by monthly kWh.
scriptBasis: Claude draft from the 104-episode backlog title/angle, V1.1 brand lines; claims checked online 2026-11-24.

sources: Sources: U.S. DOE Office of Science; NOAA SciJinks

cues.text: Umuulan. May silbi pa ba ang solar mo?
Oo, pero mas mahina ang output.
Kapag maulap, nababawasan ang liwanag sa panels.
Kaya bumababa ang output, minsan malaki ang bawas.
Pero madalas hindi zero, dahil may diffuse light pa rin.
Ang tamang tingin: kWh sa buong buwan, hindi isang araw.
cues.say: Ang tamang tingin: kilowatt-hours sa buong buwan, hindi isang araw.

cues.text: Dahil ang gusto ni Kuya SoLight… naka-solar ka na, SoSmart ka pa!

claims.wording: Clouds and rain reduce solar output, sometimes substantially.
claims.caveats: Reduction varies with cloud thickness; no percentage named.
